snippet.title: Virtua Racing Arcade Game-Play HD
snippet.description:
Virtua Racing will always and forever be GAMING GOLD.....
Remember when you first saw this in the Arcade and totally got blown away by the 3D graphics !!!!!! What a game for being first released in 1993, the game also passes the test of time its just as fun and good looking as it ever was.
A+++++++
